cases.title: Measured inventory and undo
cases.input: 150 g stock; valid and invalid amounts/dates. Add, edit, remove, then undo the latest safe edit.
cases.expected: Required fields and unit/decimal limits are enforced; successful changes show actor/time; undo cannot overwrite a later change.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed.

cases.title: Photo draft and atomic batch
cases.input: Food/non-food fixtures and a stale batch. Upload, review detected drafts, enter amount/date and save.
cases.expected: Detection alone saves nothing. Invalid or stale batches save nothing; successful retry-safe batch saves once. Manual entry remains available.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed; real-camera/recognition acceptance remains.

cases.title: Eligibility, staples and score
cases.input: Past/today/3/4/7/8-day stock, exclusions and selected/deselected staples. Generate and rank controlled candidates.
cases.expected: Ineligible references and overdraw fail; staples add no points/deductions. A 4/6 point fixture scores 66.6667%; ties follow the SRS.
cases.result: Automated assertions and supplementary calculation passed.

cases.title: Independent illustrations and retries
cases.input: Three eligible recipe tickets; transient and auth/quota image failures. Request images and retry.
cases.expected: Requests run concurrently; one automatic retry only for temporary failure. Images can fail while the recipe stays usable. Cache/ticket checks reject unauthorised access.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed; three live sample images also succeeded.

cases.title: Competing cooks
cases.input: 150 g and two concurrent 100 g claims. Then restock 200 g and retry the second claim.
cases.expected: Exactly one initial start succeeds; the other conflicts without a partial hold. Recorded 150 g remains unchanged. Restock permits both holds.
cases.result: SQL and all four browser configurations passed.

cases.title: Resume and retry start
cases.input: One active persisted session. Reload, repeat its start and renew.
cases.expected: Reload restores the selection; repeated start creates no duplicate hold. Renewal requires an active permitted session.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed.

cases.title: Actual use and retry safety
cases.input: After restock, 350 g with two 100 g holds. Try 251 g use, then 225 g. Repeat confirmation and submit a stale version.
cases.expected: 251 g is rejected; 225 g leaves 125 g, preserving the other 100 g. Successful retry does not deduct twice; stale writes save nothing.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed.

cases.title: Cancel and lease expiry
cases.input: Active and expired sessions. Close confirmation, cancel, expire and try renewal/reacquisition.
cases.expected: Closing the form retains holds. Cancel releases them without stock/outcome changes. Expired holds stop reducing availability; reacquisition rechecks stock.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed.

cases.title: Protect held stock
cases.input: An active hold. Try reducing stock below it, changing identity/unit, deleting and undoing; then restock.
cases.expected: Destructive/conflicting changes fail without partial writes. A permitted restock succeeds.
cases.result: SQL assertions passed.

cases.title: Membership and foreign access
cases.input: Owner, member, outsider and active sessions. Transfer, remove/leave/move/delete and call foreign or direct-client paths.
cases.expected: Transfer preserves sessions; affected membership cleanup releases holds. Outsider and protected direct-client writes are denied.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed.

cases.title: Combined confirmation and refresh failure
cases.input: 500 g, 100 g use and 25 g discard with reason. Review Left, save, then fail the next state refresh.
cases.expected: Left is 375 g; explicit confirmation saves stock/outcome/events together. A failed post-save refresh cannot reopen an already-saved form or deduct again.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed.

cases.title: Analytics and incomplete history
cases.input: g/ml quantity events, renamed snapshots, missing expiry, empty periods and Singapore day/week boundaries. Inspect charts and records.
cases.expected: 25/125 and 50/250 each give 20%, separately by unit. Near-expiry includes days 0–3, excludes 4 and marks missing snapshots untracked. Empty history is not reported as proven zero waste.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed; full readability acceptance remains.

cases.title: Authentication and independent sessions
cases.input: Valid/invalid credentials and two sessions for one local account. Request recovery, sign out one session and force the other to refresh.
cases.expected: Invalid login fails; recovery request is handled; local sign-out preserves the other session's renewal. Standard registration and private-demo restrictions follow mode.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed; complete email recovery remains.

cases.title: Ownership, exclusions and isolation
cases.input: Owner/member/outsider accounts and a valid/invalid join code. Save exclusions, join/leave, transfer and attempt forbidden owner actions.
cases.expected: Exclusions persist and apply to requests. Exactly one owner remains. Former owners/members cannot use revoked powers; deletion rules protect households with other members.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed.

cases.title: Shared refresh and UI states
cases.input: Two controlled browser contexts. Change an item; focus/poll the other, then repeat an unchanged refresh.
cases.expected: Changed amounts receive feedback, unchanged state stays quiet; drafts and required state transitions remain usable. Narrow layouts do not overflow.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed; real two-device and complete keyboard review remain.

cases.title: Invalid routes and tickets
cases.input: Missing authentication, bad origin/JSON, forged/expired/wrong-user tickets and foreign household access.
cases.expected: Server rejects requests without authorised writes; RLS and RPC checks work independently of hidden controls.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed.

cases.title: Live quality
cases.input: Ten scenario types, first retained repetition. Check deterministic constraints and score all displayed meals under the versioned semantic rubric.
cases.expected: At least eight scenarios pass and no displayed hard-check violation; retain failures, explanations and comparisons.
cases.result: QA review completed by See Toh Jin Jie. Nine of ten scenarios meet the rubric; Vegetarian fails. Vegetarian and preparation-liquid findings remain open.

cases.title: Live recipe-ready timing
cases.input: Twenty actual browser submissions with fixed model/configuration. End at first recipe heading; time images separately.
cases.expected: At least 18 display recipes within 45 s. Empty/errors count as failures and retries stay in the recorded request.
cases.result: 18/20 meet current criterion. Recorded local conditions; hosted observation remains separate.

cases.title: Restore and release records
cases.input: Private local dump with an active 100 g hold. Restore into a newly named database; compare fingerprints, counts and RLS; remove only the new restore DB.
cases.expected: All ten table fingerprints/counts and public RLS count match. Source remains untouched; configuration/migration and evidence records identify the candidate.
cases.result: Active-hold drill passed in 3.621 s. Hosted retention/recovery, final manifest and receipt remain.

cases.title: Recorded load setup
cases.input: Six concurrent local readers, two households, 50 items and 500 outcomes each.
cases.expected: State requests remain isolated and timing/environment is recorded. This does not establish large-scale hosted capacity.
cases.result: All four browser configurations passed.

cases.title: Demo apparatus
cases.input: A designated demo household with seeded history and member exclusions. Reset; use saved recipes that fit current constraints.
cases.expected: Reset replaces only its demo data/preferences and preserves accounts/usage records. Saved recipes are labelled and revalidated. It is not production recovery.
cases.result: Automated assertions passed. Supporting apparatus, not a main product feature.
